_what: Who publishes each source host, so a page can say 'the UK Foreign Office' instead of a hostname. These are facts about who owns a domain, not claims about any provider: diplo.de is the German Federal Foreign Office, esteri.it the Italian ministry, diplomatie.gouv.fr the French one, gov.uk the UK government. Anything not matched here renders as its bare hostname, which is what the cards already do.

_kinds.consular: A government publishing a list of providers who work in its own language.
_kinds.directory: A commercial directory. It may sell placement, and it usually makes one claim about a whole roster rather than about a named business.
_kinds.register: A government register or statutory chamber that publishes what each provider is required by law to report about itself, including the languages it accepts patients in.
_kinds.government: A national or city government, or a public agency, publishing its own list of providers and the languages they serve customers in.
